discription: A basic FM (Frequency Modulation) synth with carrier and modulator, enveloped.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0, carRatio=1, modRatio=2, modIndex=1; var car, mod, sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); mod = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio); car = SinOsc.ar(freq * carRatio + (mod * (freq * modRatio * modIndex))); sig = car * amp * env; sig = Pan2.ar(sig, pan); Out.ar(out, sig); }
